title: File-based agent project management
titleZh: 基于文件的 Agent 项目管理
summary: File boundaries and reading paths help agents find current work, applicable rules, and the sources behind a result.
summaryZh: 用文件归属与读取路径定位当前任务、适用规则和结果来源，减少接手时的上下文歧义。
ownership: I directed and reviewed the changes to my project workflows; Codex implemented the files and helped check them.
ownershipZh: 我提出并审查工作流的修改，Codex 完成文件实现并协助核对。

title: AIQuant
summary: An AI-assisted research system connecting a data lake, reusable Skills, strategy experiments, and shadow evaluation. No candidate is currently promotion-ready.
summaryZh: 连接数据湖、可复用 Skills、策略实验与影子评估的 AI 辅助研究系统。目前没有达到晋级条件的候选策略。
ownership: My personal project, developed with Codex. It is a research system; it does not establish stable profit or live trading.
ownershipZh: 我的个人项目，由我与 Codex 持续推进。成果是研究系统，不代表稳定盈利或实盘交易。

title: BioFlow: multi-omics data pipeline
summary: A five-stage workflow for literature discovery, PDFs, accession extraction, dataset construction, and metadata. Rules handle deterministic work; language models handle selected text judgments.
summaryZh: 以文献、PDF、accession、数据集构建和元数据为五个阶段；确定性步骤交给规则，部分文本判断交给语言模型。
ownership: A laboratory project I worked on. Team outcomes and individual work are kept separate; later Nova / Sentinel prototypes need their own validation.
ownershipZh: 我参与的实验室项目。团队成果与个人工作分别描述；后续 Nova / Sentinel 原型需单独核验。

title: Image Reconstruction Through Multiple 1D Approximations
titleZh: 多重一维近似图像重建
summary: My master’s thesis explores image reconstruction through multiple one-dimensional projections, interpolation, and sample selection under a fixed representation budget.
summaryZh: 硕士论文研究在固定表示预算下，怎样通过多个一维投影、插值与采样选择重建图像。
ownership: I conducted the thesis research and comparisons. Sampling choices that failed are part of the story, alongside the successful settings.
ownershipZh: 我完成论文研究与比较。失败的采样方案和有效的设置一样，都是这项工作的组成部分。

title: SCage / TempoFactor
summary: Modeling sample time and cell state, then asking what survives held-out evaluation and downstream analysis. Local spatial ordering remains a limited observation.
summaryZh: 建模样本时间与细胞状态，再检查哪些结论能经受留出评估和下游分析。局部空间排序仍是有限观察。
ownership: I contribute to model refactoring, benchmarks, attribution and validation. Spatial predictions do not establish lineage, absolute speed, or mechanism.
ownershipZh: 我参与模型重构、benchmark、归因和验证。空间预测不能证明谱系、绝对发育速度或机制。

title: Neural Fields for Spatial Transcriptomics
titleZh: 空间转录组的 Neural Field 探索
summary: Coordinate-based expression modeling exposed a useful failure: fitting observed points well did not guarantee interpolation across sparsely observed slices.
summaryZh: 基于坐标的表达建模留下了一个有用的失败：已观测点拟合得好，并不保证跨稀疏切片的插值可靠。
ownership: I reimplemented a coordinate-to-latent pipeline and compared models. SUICA, STINR and other reference methods belong to their original authors.
ownershipZh: 我重实现了坐标到 latent 的流程并比较模型。SUICA、STINR 等参考方法属于原作者。

title: Bona: YOLO training and visual control
summary: YOLO-family training for household-object detection, plus a separate real-time visual-control prototype from the same internship. Server-side training was not robot deployment.
summaryZh: 同一段实习中的家居物体 YOLO 系列训练与另一个实时视觉控制原型。服务器训练不等于机器人端部署。
ownership: My work included model and training experiments. The detection task and the visual-control prototype are separate technical strands.
ownershipZh: 我的工作包含模型与训练实验。检测任务和视觉控制原型是两条分别核验的技术线。

title: Bus Equity
summary: A team analysis of transit equity in Greater Boston. My documented responsibility was regional differences, with participation across the wider analysis.
summaryZh: 团队分析大波士顿地区的公交公平性。我在文档中主责地区差异分析，并参与更广的分析流程。
ownership: I owned the regional-analysis question and presented another question for the team. The complete analysis was a team result.
ownershipZh: 我主责地区分析问题，并为团队代讲另一个问题。整体分析属于团队成果。

title: Data Days for Good
summary: A team R Shiny product built from survey data and free text. My reported focus was cleaning comments, sentiment groups, and frequent words.
summaryZh: 基于问卷和自由文本的团队 R Shiny 产品。我确认的个人重点是评论清洗、情绪分组与高频词。
ownership: I contributed text analysis; the application was delivered by the team. The exact classifier and my share of reactive code remain unverified.
ownershipZh: 我参与文本分析，应用由团队共同交付。具体分类器和 reactive 代码分工尚未核实。
